raw.query: SELECT model,mode,variate,resolution,ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END)::numeric,4) w_h1,ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END)::numeric,4) w_h12,ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END)-MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END))::numeric,4) delta,ROUND(((MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END)-MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END))/MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END))::numeric,4) rel_deg FROM forecast_metrics WHERE model='toto' AND span='common' AND candidate='point' AND resolution IN ('45s','1min') GROUP BY model,mode,variate,resolution ORDER BY variate,resolution,mode
raw.observed: toto cov requests at 45s (12*45s=540s=9min median onset): WAPE h1=0.3822, h12=0.3968, Δ=+0.0146 (3.8% rel); at 1min: h1=0.3337, h12=0.3315, Δ=-0.0022 (-0.7% rel). All variates at 45s: ≤4.2% rel degradation. Median burst onset=9min from eda_burst_episode (30 episodes).
raw.claimed: accuracy degrades only marginally across a twelve-step horizon covering the median burst onset
raw.evidence: At the resolution where 12 steps covers the median burst onset (45s: 12×45s=9min), the best model's WAPE rises from 0.3822 (h=1) to 0.3968 (h=12) on the primary requests signal, a +0.0146 absolute increase (3.8% relative).
